name: High-Quality Wavelet Splatting
definition: A volume rendering method based on wavelet splat and multiresolution approximation grids that allows full control over approximation error and achieves the smallest error for a given sampling step size.
summary: High-Quality Wavelet Splatting is a volume rendering technique that uses wavelet pyramids and least-squares approximation to achieve minimal error and rapid complexity decay for high-quality, fast rendering of large volumes.
